# PocketKit catalogue guide

PocketKit groups named text entries into catalogues so readers can look up the text associated with a name.

## Import and minimal example

```cangjie
import pocketkit.*

func catalogueExample(): Unit {
    let entry = Entry()
}
```

## Catalogue workflow

Create named entries, group them into a text catalogue, and use the catalogue as the single place to organize the text used by an application. This longer explanation belongs only on this conceptual page, not on the package API index.

The authoritative workflow marker is **catalogue-workflow-full-text**.
